login.title: Staff sign in

tree.empty: No groups yet. Start with a main group such as हिन्दु (H), or add them all at once.
tree.bulkUnder: Each row becomes a group under {code}, numbered in order. Paste rows from a spreadsheet into the first cell.
tree.bulkPujasIn: Each row becomes a puja filed in {code}. Paste rows from a spreadsheet into the first cell.

levels.intro: The heading of each level of the group tree, top level first. The tree and the website show them.

password.title: Change password
password.note: You will be signed out everywhere and sign in again with the new one.
password.same: Pick a password you have not used here
password.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password
password.changed: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

bulk.title: Add many: {what}
bulk.hint: Type a row per record, or copy rows from Excel or Google Sheets and paste them into the first cell. Empty rows are skipped.

ritualTypes.title: Ritual types
